about_the_game:
0x13: Prelude.exe 💻⚡

Step into the neon-lit world of 0x13 with Prelude.exe, a fast-paced cyberpunk hack-and-slash RPG demo. This early build gives you a taste of the game’s core mechanics: fluid parkour 🏃‍♂️, brutal melee combat ⚔️, and lightning-fast action ⚡.

In this vertical slice, you’ll experience a high-intensity boss fight 🕹️ and get a feel for the game’s speed, challenge, and cyberpunk atmosphere. While this demo is still a work in progress, it showcases the foundations of what’s to come in the full game.

Key Features in Prelude.exe:

  • Hack-and-Slash Combat ⚔️: Fast, punishing melee battles against challenging enemies.

  • Parkour Movement 🏃‍♂️: Seamlessly run, jump, and climb across environments to outmaneuver foes.

  • Boss Encounter 🕹️: Test your skills in an intense and strategic boss fight.

  • Early Systems Preview 💾: Get a sneak peek at mechanics and progression still under development.

⚠️ Note: This demo represents a work-in-progress. Certain features, polish, and systems will be expanded in the full game.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following content that may not be suitable for all audiences:

Violence & Combat: Intense battles with blood effects and fantasy violence.

Strong Language: Occasional use of coarse language in dialogue.

The game does not include sexual content, sexual assault, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 (8 GB) or AMD RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
